## Problem and change

What concrete behavior or requirement changes, and why?

## Evidence

List the checks performed and their results. Link relevant requirements, capability
cells, fixtures and source revisions. Separate synthetic checks from runtime evidence.

## Compatibility and safety

Describe affected inputs/outputs, preservation or privacy behavior, and remaining
limitations. For a documentation-only change, say so.

## Provenance and credit

Identify new material's origin and permission/notice requirements. Do not attach
private media or credentials. Follow [contribution guidance](https://github.com/imageinfo/imageinfo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
and [security reporting](https://github.com/imageinfo/imageinfo/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for sensitive concerns.
